newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Alliance, Labour talks teams to meet - Alliance.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Alliance, Labour talks teams to meet - Alliance.

text.p: The negotiating teams of the Labour Party and the left-wing Alliance Party will meet on Wednesday afternoon, an Alliance spokesman told Reuters on Tuesday.
He said the Alliance had received a letter from Labour leader Helen Clark and Clark and Alliance leader Jim Anderton had spoken on the telephone to arrange details of the meeting.
The spokesman said a joint statement would be issued on Wednesday morning outlining the topics to be discussed at the meeting.
A Labour caucus source had earlier told Reuters that after Tuesday's caucus meeting Labour would be seeking talks with the Alliance to clarify its position on votes of confidence and supply.
The Alliance has said it would not support the caretaker National Party government but wants to be consulted on the shape of a possible Labour-NZ First Party government.
The nationalist NZ First Party has been in coalition talks with Labour and National for six weeks since the October 12 election left it holding the balance of power.
